subject: Coord: Jordan Reeves — technical loop orchestration, Zoom rooms & accessibility
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@gmail.com>
Cc: Acme Talent <talent@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Technical loop scheduling — candidate: Jordan Reeves

Hi all,

We have Jordan Reeves progressing to the technical loop for Backend Eng (IC3). I wanted to lock in rooms and share a working agenda. Proposed schedule (all PT):
- 10:00–10:30 — Systems design (Laura)
- 10:40–11:10 — Backend implementation / coding (Dev)
- 11:20–11:40 — Culture + Qs (Tessa)

Please note 10-minute buffer between interviews; candidate is on PT so times above assume West Coast availability. Jordan, can you confirm these windows?

I've provisioned a single Zoom meeting with break-out rooms; details below will be updated once we confirm accommodations.

Zoom (provisional): https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (passcode: 4821)
[Attachment: panel-agenda-20260211.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]

Panel prep notes: try to keep the whiteboard prompt focused on API design + scaling (15m), leave 10m for candidate questions. Dev — bring the coding prompt in a shared gist.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
[Attachment: JD-Backend-Engineer.pdf]

From: Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@gmail.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Talent <talent@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical loop scheduling — candidate: Jordan Reeves

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the invite and the agenda. Those times work for me. A quick accessibility note: I use automatic captions for live meetings and I also benefit from a 10-minute decompression buffer after an intensive coding session (helps me refocus). Could you enable live captions/auto-transcript in Zoom and add an extra 10-minute break after the coding interview? If adding an extra 10 minutes to the schedule isn't possible, a 5-minute extension plus the buffer would help.

Also, I prefer to do the coding prompt in a pair-programming style where I share my screen; happy to do either.

Thanks again — looking forward to it.
Jordan

On Wed, Feb 11, 2026 at 09:12 Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi all,
> 
> We have Jordan Reeves progressing to the technical loop for Backend Eng (IC3). I wanted to lock in rooms and share a working agenda...

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Reeves <jordan.reeves@gmail.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 13:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical loop scheduling — candidate: Jordan Reeves

Thanks Jordan — great note and appreciate the heads up. We'll enable live captions and set up the schedule with an extra 10-minute buffer after the coding portion. Updated logistics below (PT):
- 10:00–10:30 — Systems design (Laura)
- 10:40–11:15 — Backend implementation / coding (Dev) — coding session extended to 35m, followed by 10m buffer for debrief/break
- 11:25–11:45 — Culture + Qs (Tessa)

I've created separate Zoom break-out rooms and turned on live automatic captions (Zoom live transcriptions are enabled). Revised meeting link (same meeting, pinned rooms): https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (passcode: 4821)

Panel — quick prep for everyone:
- Laura: design prompt — please keep slide with constraints under 6 bullets and assume candidate draws an API + data flow on the whiteboard.
- Dev: bring the coding prompt as a single function to implement; candidate will share screen and drive. Please allow 10m for running through test cases rather than whiteboarding every edge case.
- Tessa: 10 minutes for culture + Qs; we want to leave candidate time for final questions.

I've attached an updated agenda with explicit buffers and meeting roles. Also added a short recruiter prep section for red flags and interviewer rubric pointers.
[Attachment: updated-agenda-with-buffers-20260211.pdf]

If you have concerns or need to swap times, let me know by EOD. I'll inform Acme Talent and Jordan of the confirmed schedule and accommodations.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com

[Candidate accommodation notes added to the panel doc — see updated attachment]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical loop scheduling — candidate: Jordan Reeves

Thanks Grace — appreciate the update and the accommodation note. I'll open with a 2-minute framing of the design prompt and keep my slides pared down. I'll also ensure we stick to the timing so Jordan has the buffer.

One quick ask for panelists: please flag any accessibility concerns or follow-ups in the debrief doc immediately after your interview so we can capture context while it's fresh. If anything pops up, ping me and I'll coordinate with recruiting.

Laura Bennett
Senior Engineering Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

Perfect — thanks for accommodating the captions and extra buffer. The updated agenda looks great; appreciate the clear roles for the panel. I'll join at 09:55 PT to test audio and captions. Looking forward to meeting everyone.

Best,
Jordan
